en: Black‑and‑white, old photograph of a European town square with a large Baroque/Renaissance‑style building dominating the scene. The building has a steep tiled roof with dormer windows, ornate window frames, and several shopfronts at street level. A few pruned trees line the facade, and people in early 20th‑century clothing—women in long dresses and wide‑brimmed hats, men in suits and hats, and children—are walking or standing in the cobblestoned square. A church spire rises in the background on the right. There is a shop sign on the central facade that appears to read "E.A.C." above an awning.
